text: New Era Cap is controlled by its founding family, with private equity firm ACON Investments holding a significant minority stake; the company was started in 1920 by Ehrhardt Koch and is now led by Chris Koch, the fourth-generation scion of the family.
short: New Era: controlled by the founding Koch family; ACON Investments holds a significant minority stake.

source.name: FashionNetwork (Reuters): U.S. sports league caps maker New Era prepares for IPO
source.quote: The company, which is controlled by its founding family and in which private equity firm ACON Investments holds a significant minority stake, aims to go public in 2024

additionalSources.name: ACON Investments: ACON Portfolio Investment, New Era, to Acquire '47, Creating Premier Global Sport and Lifestyle Company
additionalSources.quote: New Era is a portfolio company of ACON, a Washington, D.C.-based private equity firm.

additionalSources.name: PR Newswire: ACON Investments Closes Approximately $700 Million Continuation Fund for New Era Cap, LLC
additionalSources.quote: New Era Cap will continue to be led by Chris Koch, its fourth-generation CEO, whose great grandfather, Ehrhardt Koch, founded New Era Cap in 1920 in Buffalo, New York.
